text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Placed on the board... I made it onto the 
board, but...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...Not yet. It's still not enough... If I 
want to stand at the 'summit'..."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
—...I will accept this result sincerely. 
Let's formulate countermeasures 
immediately to aim even higher in the next 
race.
